$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for this project's responsive breakpoints (lift-and-shift: adopted from the source site https://www.ustafoundation.com). See AGENTS.md → The Breakpoint Rule and skills/responsive-breakpoints. Decided ONCE at the start of the migration — do NOT re-litigate per task.
sampledPages: https://www.ustafoundation.com/en/home.html (clientlibs: foundation main + usta-foundation base/proxy + components common + inline styles)

grid.containerNote: CONTENT COLUMN (reconciled 2026-09-23 vs customer spec + live re-measure). MOBILE (<768): fixed 336 centered (customer @mobile/@small-mobile). TABLET (768-991): 720. DESKTOP (>=992): ONE fluid tier — container capped at 1200 with a 15px gutter each side, so content = min(viewport,1200)-30 = fluid 962@992 -> 1070@1100 -> 1169@1199, CLAMPED at 1170 from 1200 up. Customer spec states @desktop(>=992) content max-width:1200 = the OUTER container (1200-2x15 gutter = 1170 content). NOT a fixed 970 plateau (old value; was ~199px too narrow at 1199). Impl: styles.css main > .section > div. Gutter 30px = .row margin -15px + col padding 15px. Full deep-dive + EDS mapping: docs/source-css-system.md.
grid.unitsNote: SOURCE IS PIXEL-FIRST (~13.4k px vs ~73 rem; html font-size 10px so 1rem=10px). Author block CSS in px to match — do NOT convert fixed px to rem/em/clamp. Grid widths use %, full-bleed uses vw. Spacing scale: 4/6/8/10/12/15/16/20/24/30/40px. See docs/source-css-system.md.

notes: The source site is an AEM classic site built on the Bootstrap 3 grid; 768/992/1200 is its dominant responsive grid (min-width hits 296/101/12, with matching max-width -1 boundaries 767/991/1199 at 675/297/13). Detected via breakpoint-discover.mjs + clientlib CSS tally. Excluded as noise: 991 (the ±1 of 992), 336/720/1920 (one-offs), and 1370 (a wide-desktop max-width cap tier, mostly used above 1200). Fallback if empty: 600/900/1200.
